function.description:
**Tool Dependency: CRITICAL**

This tool retrieves the device credential settings configured for a site. It returns credential ID references only — **NOT** the actual credential details. You **MUST ALWAYS** resolve every non-null `credentialsId` with `api_getGlobalCredentials` before answering. **This is non-negotiable.**

**Credential Types Returned:**
- `CLI` - Command Line Interface credentials
- `SNMPV2_READ_COMMUNITY` - SNMPv2 read-only community string
- `SNMPV2_WRITE_COMMUNITY` - SNMPv2 read-write community string
- `SNMPV3` - SNMPv3 credentials with authentication and privacy settings
- `HTTP_READ` - HTTP read-only credentials
- `HTTP_WRITE` - HTTP read-write credentials

**Field Mapping:**
- `cliCredentialsId` → `CLI`
- `snmpv2cReadCredentialsId` → `SNMPV2_READ_COMMUNITY`
- `snmpv2cWriteCredentialsId` → `SNMPV2_WRITE_COMMUNITY`
- `snmpv3CredentialsId` → `SNMPV3`
- `httpReadCredentialsId` → `HTTP_READ`
- `httpWriteCredentialsId` → `HTTP_WRITE`
function.name: api_getDeviceCredentialSettingsForASite

_inherited.description: Whether to include inherited settings from parent sites

id.description: Site Id, retrievable from the `id` attribute in `/dna/intent/api/v1/sites`

cliCredentialsId.description: CLI credentials used to access devices assigned to the site.

httpReadCredentialsId.description: HTTP(S) Read credentials used to access devices assigned to the site.

httpWriteCredentialsId.description: HTTP(S) Write credentials used to access devices assigned to the site.

snmpv2cReadCredentialsId.description: SNMPv2c Read credentials used to access devices assigned to the site.

snmpv2cWriteCredentialsId.description: SNMPv2c Write credentials used to access devices assigned to the site.

snmpv3CredentialsId.description: SNMPv3 credentials used to access devices assigned to the site.
